properties.short_description: Crash/fatality trend and street redesign evaluation
properties.explanation: Crash/fatality trend and street redesign evaluation

properties.title: 9/11 Memorial Museum opened to the public
properties.short_description: The National September 11 Memorial Museum opened to the public at the World Trade Center site.
properties.explanation: A major memorial museum entered public use below the World Trade Center plaza.

properties.title: Arverne View development reopened after post-Sandy rehabilitation
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on October 27, 2014 the official reopening of Arverne View after post-Sandy rehabilitation work.
properties.explanation: A documented public release recorded ceremonial reopening and rehabilitation completion for a Rockaway housing complex.

properties.title: Brooklyn Bridge Park Pier 2 opened
properties.short_description: Brooklyn Bridge Park recorded Pier 2 and Pier 4 Beach opening on 22 May 2014.
properties.explanation: A major active-recreation pier entered public use with courts, skating, swings, fitness areas, and waterfront access.

properties.title: Central Ridgewood Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: The NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report records the Central Ridgewood Historic District designation in Queens on December 9, 2014.
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-designation status change was recorded for the named site.

properties.title: Cooper Hewitt reopened after Carnegie Mansion renovation
properties.short_description: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum announced that the renovated and restored Carnegie Mansion would open to the public on December 12, 2014.
properties.explanation: A museum campus in the landmark Carnegie Mansion returned to public use after a three-year renovation and restoration.

properties.title: CUNY Advanced Science Research Center opened at City College
properties.short_description: CUNY ASRC records nanoscientists moving into the new Advanced Science Research Center building in September 2014, with further resident and visiting researchers joining over the following year.
properties.explanation: A new CUNY-wide interdisciplinary science building entered research use on the City College south campus.

properties.title: Fordham McKeon Hall and Law School entered use at Lincoln Center
properties.short_description: Fordham Now recorded students arriving at McKeon Hall and Law School faculty and staff using the unified new Lincoln Center space at the start of September 2014.
properties.explanation: A new mixed academic, law school, and residence-hall building entered university use on Fordham's Lincoln Center campus.

properties.title: Fulton Center opened in Lower Manhattan
properties.short_description: Fulton Center opened after reconstruction of the Lower Manhattan subway interchange.
properties.explanation: A new transit concourse and station headhouse entered public passenger use.

properties.title: Governors Island Park Phase 1 opened
properties.short_description: Governors Island history records the first 30 acres of new park opening to the public in May 2014.
properties.explanation: Liggett Terrace, Hammock Grove, Play Lawn, and related southern-island park spaces entered public use.

properties.title: Hamilton Avenue asphalt plant reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: Ribbon Cutting: Hamilton Avenue Asphalt Plant records "Hamilton Avenue asphalt plant reopened after renovation" with source date 2014-05-14.
properties.explanation: A documented official agency news archive recorded municipal asphalt plant renovation and reopening.

properties.title: High Line at the Rail Yards opened
properties.short_description: Friends of the High Line press material records the High Line at the Rail Yards opening to the public on 21 September 2014.
properties.explanation: The third and northernmost phase of the High Line entered public use around the West Side rail yards.

properties.title: Irish Repertory Theatre renovation groundbreaking was recorded
properties.short_description: NYC DDC's news archive records a September 5, 2014 groundbreaking for a renovation of Irish Repertory Theatre.
properties.explanation: A documented city design-and-construction news record marked the start of a theatre renovation and accessibility upgrade.

properties.title: Lincoln Medical Center emergency department modernization was marked complete
properties.short_description: NYC Health + Hospitals' official press release records an opening event for Lincoln Medical Center's modernized emergency department on April 4, 2014.
properties.explanation: A documented completion milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: The Met David H. Koch Plaza opened after reconstruction
properties.short_description: The Metropolitan Museum of Art announced that the rebuilt David H. Koch Plaza opened to the public on September 10, 2014 after a two-year reconstruction.
properties.explanation: A 70,000-square-foot museum-front plaza and fountain landscape reopened along Fifth Avenue.

properties.title: New School University Center opened
properties.short_description: The New School's University Center opened in Greenwich Village in 2014 as a new academic, student-life, and residence building.
properties.explanation: A new higher-education building entered use on Fifth Avenue.

properties.title: Norman Towers development opened in Downtown Jamaica
properties.short_description: NYC HDC announced on October 30, 2014 a ribbon-cutting for the 161st Street Apartments, also known as Norman Towers, in Downtown Jamaica.
properties.explanation: A documented public housing-finance release recorded opening of mixed-income housing with ground-floor commercial and office space.

properties.title: NYBG completed Rock Garden cascade and stream restoration
properties.short_description: The New York Botanical Garden's 2014 Annual Report recorded completion of a two-year restoration of the historic Rock Garden cascade and stream.
properties.explanation: A documented completion or restoration milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: NYPD Police Academy opened in College Point
properties.short_description: NYPD records that the 32-acre Police Academy campus in College Point opened its doors in 2014, consolidating earlier training facilities into one central location.
properties.explanation: A new police training campus entered use in College Point, Queens.

properties.title: New York Hall of Science Design Lab opened
properties.short_description: The New York Hall of Science press material records Design Lab opening on June 7, 2014 as a permanent exhibition and activity environment in the lower level of the Central Pavilion.
properties.explanation: A new permanent design-learning environment opened inside the New York Hall of Science's Central Pavilion.

properties.title: Ocean Breeze Riding Facility groundbreaking was recorded
properties.short_description: NYC DDC's news archive records a May 30, 2014 groundbreaking for the Ocean Breeze Riding Facility in Staten Island.
properties.explanation: A documented city design-and-construction news record marked the start of construction for an accessible therapeutic riding facility.

properties.title: One World Trade Center opened for office occupancy
properties.short_description: Employees arrived for the first day of work at One World Trade Center, marking the tower's opening phase.
properties.explanation: The tallest tower on the rebuilt World Trade Center campus entered office use.

properties.title: Park Avenue Historic District was designated
properties.short_description: NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission map materials record the Park Avenue Historic District, LP-02547, as designated on April 29, 2014.
properties.explanation: A documented heritage-designation status change was recorded for the named site.

properties.title: SculptureCenter inaugurated its expanded and renovated building
properties.short_description: SculptureCenter's official exhibition page dates Puddle, pothole, portal from October 2, 2014 and states that the exhibition inaugurated the newly expanded and renovated building in Long Island City.
properties.explanation: A documented opening or public-use milestone was recorded for the named facility.

properties.title: Tavern on the Green reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: NYC Department of Design and Construction recorded Tavern on the Green reopening to the public on 24 April 2014 after renovation of the Central Park restaurant building.
properties.explanation: A renovated historic Central Park restaurant building returned to public dining use.

properties.title: Urban Post-Disaster Housing Prototype ribbon cutting was recorded
properties.short_description: NYC DDC's news archive records a June 10, 2014 ribbon cutting for the Urban Post-Disaster Housing Prototype installed adjacent to NYC Emergency Management headquarters in Brooklyn.
properties.explanation: A documented city design-and-construction news record marked public debut of a three-story interim housing prototype.

properties.title: Washington Heights Library reopened after renovation
properties.short_description: NYC DDC recorded a 4 March 2014 ribbon cutting after a full exterior renovation of NYPL's Washington Heights Library.
properties.explanation: A renovated branch library returned to documented public use with exterior restoration, window work, masonry repairs, and access improvements.

properties.title: Washington Square Park comfort station and final restoration amenities opened
properties.short_description: Ribbon Cutting: Washington Square Park Comfort Station records "Washington Square Park comfort station and final restoration amenities opened" with source date 2014-06-10.
properties.explanation: A documented official agency news archive recorded park comfort station, maintenance facility, and public-realm restoration phase.

properties.title: Weill Cornell Belfer Research Building opened
properties.short_description: Cornell Chronicle recorded Weill Cornell Medical College opening the Belfer Research Building in January 2014, with a ribbon-cutting ceremony on 31 January.
properties.explanation: A new 18-storey translational research building entered institutional use on the Weill Cornell campus.
